L=/var/lib/bench67371561
T=$L/current/args/containerd-template.toml
# the plugin is enabled in the template (the launcher renders it at every start); the node is stopped and started
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import re
p = "/var/lib/bench67371561/current/args/containerd-template.toml"
s = open(p).read()
open(p, "w").write(re.sub(r"(?m)^disabled_plugins\s*=.*$", "disabled_plugins = []", s))
PY
sudo $L/bin/mk8sctl stop
sudo $L/bin/mk8sctl start
sudo crictl -r unix://$L/common/run/containerd.sock -i unix://$L/common/run/containerd.sock version

L=/var/lib/bench67371561
T=$L/current/args/containerd-template.toml
# the asker's try: the generated file is replaced by the default configuration, but the launcher makes it again from the template
sudo sh -c "containerd config default > $L/current/args/containerd.toml"
sudo $L/bin/mk8sctl restart
sudo $L/bin/mk8sctl status

L=/var/lib/bench67371561
T=$L/current/args/containerd-template.toml
# the template is right, but the running containerd read its configuration at its start
sudo sed -i "s#^disabled_plugins = .*#disabled_plugins = []#" $T
sudo $L/bin/mk8sctl status

L=/var/lib/bench67371561
T=$L/current/args/containerd-template.toml
# the kubelet is pointed at the containerd of the host: another runtime, not the node's
sudo sed -i "s#^--container-runtime-endpoint=.*#--container-runtime-endpoint=/run/containerd/containerd.sock#" $L/current/args/kubelet
sudo $L/bin/mk8sctl status

L=/var/lib/bench67371561
T=$L/current/args/containerd-template.toml
# the node's containerd is stopped and another one with the plugin enabled is started by hand on the node's socket, outside the launcher
sudo $L/bin/mk8sctl stop
sudo sed -e "s#\${SNAP_DATA}#$L/current#g" -e "s#\${SNAP_COMMON}#$L/common#g" -e "s#^disabled_plugins = .*#disabled_plugins = []#" $T | sudo tee /var/lib/bench67371561/by-hand.toml >/dev/null
sudo sh -c "setsid nohup containerd --config /var/lib/bench67371561/by-hand.toml >/dev/null 2>&1 &"
sleep 3
sudo crictl -r unix://$L/common/run/containerd.sock -i unix://$L/common/run/containerd.sock version
